news.title: For schools, cyber resilience starts at the data layer
news.summary_en: Cyber resilience in education starts at the data layer. That is because the data layer is where schools’ most important information lives and where recovery begins when something goes wrong.

news.title: Belonging by design: Practical ways to support adult learners in hybrid and asynchronous courses
news.summary_en: For many adult learners, logging into a hybrid or asynchronous course is not the beginning of their day. It may come after a full shift at work, after helping children with homework, after managing caregiving responsibilities, or after years away from formal schooling.
